name: Add-on Popularity
query:
SELECT
    addon.item AS "Add-on Type:Link/Airplane Ticket Add-on Type:200",
    COUNT(addon.name) AS "Sold Count:Int:120"
FROM `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item` addon
INNER JOIN `tabAirplane Ticket` ticket
    ON ticket.name = addon.parent AND addon.parenttype = 'Airplane Ticket'
WHERE ticket.docstatus < 2
GROUP BY addon.item
ORDER BY COUNT(addon.name) DESC
